input.summary: Move the merits forum in Section 15.6 from JAMS arbitration (redacted seat) to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, and conform the residual arbitration machinery and the interim-relief carve-out in the operative text.
input.comment: [Playbook] New York law already governs, but the merits forum is JAMS arbitration in an undisclosed seat; our position requires the state and federal courts in New York County to have exclusive jurisdiction, subject only to interim injunctive relief elsewhere. We have replaced the arbitration referral in Section 15.6(a), removed the residual arbitration machinery in Section 15.6(b)-(e) and the JAMS/award text, and conformed Sections 15.6(f), (g), (i) and (j) so the punitive-damages waiver, the stay of termination and the interim-relief carve-out survive without reference to an arbitration that no longer exists.

The arbitrators may award to the prevailing Party, if any, as determined by the arbitrators, the costs and attorneys' fees reasonably incurred by the prevailing Party in connection with the arbitration. If the arbitrators determine a Party to be the prevailing Party under circumstances where the prevailing Party won some but not all of the claims and counterclaims, the arbitrators may award the prevailing Party an appropriate percentage of the costs and attorneys' fees reasonably incurred by the prevailing Party in connection with the arbitration.
